# NEW 2026-11-21 v8.0 Yuan Early Modern Line (oe_yem_, slot 59, 1450-1750). Generated by gen_yuan_early_modern.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Any scope, monthly: called by scheduler slot 59 (gen_mainline_lock.py) or fallback pulse (oe_yem_pulse.txt).
# Idempotent per calendar month via oe_yem_ran_m. Strictly Restored Mongol Yuan CHI only (0 interference with MNG/MCH).
oe_yem_monthly = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_m value = oe_yem_m_now }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_yem_ran_m ?= global_var:oe_yem_m } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_ran_m value = global_var:oe_yem_m }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yem_init } current_date >= 1450.1.1 }
            oe_yem_setup = yes
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yem_on }
            oe_yem_end_check = yes
            if = {
                limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yem_on current_date >= 1450.1.1 }
                oe_yem_ev_step = yes
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_dbg_n_y1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_y1n value = global_var:oe_dbg_n_y1 } }
    }
}

# Any scope. First run from 1450.1.1: arm only if Restored Mongol Yuan stands before 1750.1.1.
oe_yem_setup = {
    set_global_variable = oe_yem_init
    if = {
        limit = { current_date < 1750.1.1 oe_yem_yuan_eligible = yes }
        set_global_variable = oe_yem_on
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_done value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_fleet value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_voyage_unlocked value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_silver_policy value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_run_outcome value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_west_trade value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_science value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_shenjiying value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_lia_choice value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_frontier value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_kyakhta_open value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_ind value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_legacy value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_dadu_lost_m value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_wait value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_last value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_sent_cnt value = 0 }
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_done value = 8 }
    }
}

# Any scope (COLLAPSE_HOOKS interface for gen_yuan_y3.py; also called monthly on Yuan fall or 60m loss of Dadu).
oe_yem_on_yuan_fall = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yem_on } oe_yem_finish = { code = 2 } }
    else = {
        oe_yem_strip = yes
        if = { limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_yem_done ?= 2 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_done value = 2 } }
    }
}

# Any scope. Monthly end checks: 2 Yuan fell or lost Dadu >= 60m, 1 completed via .10, 3 reached 1750.1.1.
oe_yem_end_check = {
    if = { limit = { oe_yem_yuan_ok = no } oe_yem_on_yuan_fall = yes }
    else_if = {
        limit = { oe_yem_dadu_held = no NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yem_t_force } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yem_dadu_lost_m } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_dadu_lost_m value = 0 } }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_dadu_lost_m add = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yem_dadu_lost_m trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yem_dadu_lost_m } global_var:oe_yem_dadu_lost_m >= 60 } }
            oe_yem_on_yuan_fall = yes
        }
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_dadu_lost_m value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_yem_done ?= 1 }
            remove_global_variable = oe_yem_on
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { current_date >= 1750.1.1 }
            oe_yem_close_timeout = yes
        }
    }
}

oe_yem_finish = {
    oe_yem_strip = yes
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yem_on } remove_global_variable = oe_yem_on }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yem_shenjiying } remove_global_variable = oe_yem_shenjiying }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yem_kyakhta_open } remove_global_variable = oe_yem_kyakhta_open }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_done value = $code$ }
}

oe_yem_close_timeout = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yem_on } remove_global_variable = oe_yem_on }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_done value = 3 }
}

oe_yem_count = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yem_sent_cnt } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_sent_cnt value = 0 } }
    change_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_sent_cnt add = 1 }
}

# Any scope, monthly from 1450.1.1. Lapses missed windows and sends at most one event per month (shared oe_yuan_ev_m guard).
oe_yem_ev_step = {
    if = { limit = { oe_yem_lapse_1 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_st_1 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_yem_lapse_2 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_st_2 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_yem_lapse_3 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_st_3 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_yem_lapse_4 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_st_4 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_yem_lapse_5 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_st_5 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_yem_lapse_6 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_st_6 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_yem_lapse_7 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_st_7 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_yem_lapse_8 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_st_8 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_yem_lapse_9 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_st_9 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_yem_lapse_10 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_st_10 value = 2 } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_pick value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yem_wait } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_wait value = 0 } }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { oe_yem_busy = no AND = { has_global_variable = oe_yem_wait trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yem_wait } global_var:oe_yem_wait >= 2 } } } }
        if = { limit = { oe_yem_due_4 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_pick value = 4 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_yem_due_7 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_pick value = 7 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_yem_due_1 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_pick value = 1 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_yem_due_2 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_pick value = 2 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_yem_due_3 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_pick value = 3 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_yem_due_5 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_pick value = 5 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_yem_due_6 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_pick value = 6 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_yem_due_8 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_pick value = 8 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_yem_due_9 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_pick value = 9 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_yem_due_10 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_pick value = 10 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_yem_pick ?= 0 oe_yem_busy = no }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yem_pick ?= 0 oe_yem_open_1 = yes } random = { chance = 14 set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_pick value = 1 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yem_pick ?= 0 oe_yem_open_2 = yes } random = { chance = 12 set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_pick value = 2 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yem_pick ?= 0 oe_yem_open_3 = yes } random = { chance = 14 set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_pick value = 3 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yem_pick ?= 0 oe_yem_open_4 = yes } random = { chance = 18 set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_pick value = 4 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yem_pick ?= 0 oe_yem_open_5 = yes } random = { chance = 12 set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_pick value = 5 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yem_pick ?= 0 oe_yem_open_6 = yes } random = { chance = 14 set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_pick value = 6 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yem_pick ?= 0 oe_yem_open_7 = yes } random = { chance = 20 set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_pick value = 7 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yem_pick ?= 0 oe_yem_open_8 = yes } random = { chance = 12 set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_pick value = 8 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yem_pick ?= 0 oe_yem_open_9 = yes } random = { chance = 14 set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_pick value = 9 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yem_pick ?= 0 oe_yem_open_10 = yes } random = { chance = 16 set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_pick value = 10 } } }
    }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yem_pick ?= 0 oe_yem_busy = yes oe_yem_any_due = yes } change_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_wait add = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yem_pick ?= 1 } oe_yem_fire_1 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yem_pick ?= 2 } oe_yem_fire_2 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yem_pick ?= 3 } oe_yem_fire_3 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yem_pick ?= 4 } oe_yem_fire_4 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yem_pick ?= 5 } oe_yem_fire_5 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yem_pick ?= 6 } oe_yem_fire_6 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yem_pick ?= 7 } oe_yem_fire_7 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yem_pick ?= 8 } oe_yem_fire_8 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yem_pick ?= 9 } oe_yem_fire_9 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yem_pick ?= 10 } oe_yem_fire_10 = yes }
    remove_global_variable = oe_yem_pick
}

oe_yem_test_ensure = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_t_force value = 1 }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yem_on } } set_global_variable = oe_yem_init set_global_variable = oe_yem_on set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_done value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_fleet value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_voyage_unlocked value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_silver_policy value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_run_outcome value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_west_trade value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_science value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_shenjiying value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_lia_choice value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_frontier value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_kyakhta_open value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_ind value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_legacy value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_dadu_lost_m value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_wait value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_last value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_sent_cnt value = 0 } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_m value = oe_yem_m_now }
}

        limit = { tag = CHI is_ai = no }
        oe_yem_test_ensure = yes
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_silver_policy value = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_st_3 value = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_d_silv value = oe_yem_m_now }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yem_st_4 } remove_global_variable = oe_yem_st_4 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yem_t_ev value = 1 }
        oe_yem_fire_4 = yes
    }
}
